biography:
I am a highly motivated and detail-oriented Cost Manager/Quantity Surveyor with a passion for integrating cutting-edge technology and sustainable building practices. With several years of experience in the commercial and high-tech construction sectors, I have honed my skills in managing budgets, contracts, and timelines, ensuring that projects are delivered on time and within budget.

Throughout my career, I have demonstrated my ability to thrive in high-pressure situations, keeping a level head and finding innovative solutions to any challenge that arises. I am known for my structured approach and my ability to prioritize tasks to meet deadlines, while also remaining flexible and adaptable to evolving project requirements.

As a lifelong learner, I am committed to staying up-to-date with the latest technological advancements and sustainability initiatives in the construction industry. I believe that technology and sustainability are key drivers of innovation in this field, and I am excited to explore new ways to incorporate smart building practices into my work.

If you’re looking for a driven and dedicated Cost Manager/Quantity Surveyor who can leverage the latest technologies to elevate your construction project, please don’t hesitate to reach out. I look forward to connecting with you!
